'''Mother's Milk''' was an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] nursery rhyme about the kidnapping of a [[Prince/Legends|prince]] by [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]], instectoids native to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Imodin Ganalya]] named her [[Mother's Milk project|larvae-killing serum]] after the rhyme.<ref name="Mission" />
